ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated at the peduncle junction and along the lower lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass centrally. High-contrast white mottling at the base of both lobes. Left lobe features three distinct circular low-intensity focal spots (approx. 10-15 pixels diameter) nested within a high-intensity field. Right lobe shows diffuse linear grey-scale transitions towards the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Trailing edge exhibits 'saw-tooth' peaks ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in vertical amplitude, with more pronounced, jagged peaks on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward-tapering sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, raised circular formations (barnacles) along the outer lateral edges of both the left and right lobes. Two isolated white circular ring scars are visible on the mid-ventral surface of each lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 5-7 dark, roughly parallel linear streaks (rake marks) ranging from 20 to 80 pixels in length, oriented vertically on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on lateral tips and multiple parallel rake mark scars on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical white ring-shaped scarring located near the lower center of both lobes.
